changelog: Adds the toggle script the way Jellyfin Enhanced does - its own middleware, registered as a singleton start-up filter - and drops the File Transformation route 1.3.0.1 tried. Both earlier attempts took index.html down with an ObjectDisposedException raised inside File Transformation 2.5.11.0, which resolves services lazily from a provider that is disposed after start-up; registering a transformation hits that directly, and adding a transient start-up filter disturbed start-up enough to hit it indirectly. Jellyfin Enhanced has used a singleton start-up filter alongside the same File Transformation build for a long time without trouble, so this follows it exactly.
description: Clears the first episodes of never-started series out of Next Up and collapses duplicate episodes of one series in Continue Watching, so both rows only hold shows you are actually watching. Filtering changes no watch data; an opt-in scheduled task can also clear the play state of barely-started episodes.
name: Next Up Cleanup
overview: Next Up without the first episode of every show you never started, and Continue Watching without the same show four times.
